name: archicad-mcp-aberto
description: Read and safely edit a running Archicad through the official JSON API and the Tapir add-on.
long_description: Open source MCP server for Archicad. Reads elements, properties, stories and BIM details, and creates walls, slabs and columns moves elements and sets property values with a dry run first, a single-use confirmation, per-element receipts and a check after applying. It never saves the project. Needs Archicad open and, for most tools, the free Tapir add-on.

ports.title: Archicad ports
ports.description: Ports to scan for open Archicad instances, as a range or a comma list.

write_timeout.title: Write timeout (seconds)
write_timeout.description: How long a create call waits for Archicad before the outcome is reported as unknown.
